subject: campaign-stream-textless-pending-churn
detail: campaign #23 filed by Triage (this lane holds the intake leg; outreach is withheld intake). Defect: outreach/stream/daemon.py writes the LITERAL 'pending' for every captured row, including textless ones - SQL_T0_INSERT :235-241 (VALUES (... 'pending','stream'); call site insert_new :295-298 passes text but does not branch on it) and SQL_T1_TOMBSTONE :242-250, whose statement carries NO text column at all (call site tombstone :300-305). The drain (outreach/stream/scoring.py:99-100) selects classification='pending' AND score_attempts < MAX_ATTEMPTS (5), so each textless row is picked up 5x, can only fail 'no text to classify', and parks in dead_letter - a bucket meant to mean a real verdict was attempted and failed. NOTE ON THE MECHANISM DESCRIPTION: the lane's proposed close-condition item 1 read 'both inserts write classification from text truthiness' - that is FALSE at the bytes; both hardcode the literal, so the fix is to make the literal conditional, not to correct an existing branch. The correct invariant to mirror is watch_poll.score_for_store (outreach/scripts/watch_poll.py:237-258), which writes 'pending' only when text is truthy. MEASURED 2026-09-29T07:56Z live DB: dead_letter 455 = 451 no-text/detection_source=stream (99.12%) + 4 has-text (0.88%), ratio 112.8:1; pending eligible (<5) 18, all text-bearing; rows in NO bucket 227 (classification IS NULL, all poll). THE 227 BLIND SPOT IS STRUCTURAL: v_stream_scoring_health (outreach/db/migration_v11.sql:80-93) defines scored as classification <> 'pending', and NULL <> 'pending' is NULL -> filter false, while the pending and dead_letter arms test = 'pending', likewise NULL - so a NULL row satisfies no arm of the view (view sum 18+455+6511=6984 vs table total 7211). Switching tombstones to NULL without the bucket would move them from noisy to invisible, so the bucket ships with the same change. CLOSE CONDITION: (1) both hot inserts store NULL where there is no text; (2) the view accounts for every row, pending+dead_letter+scored+no_verdict = count(*); (3) one-time re-label UPDATE ... SET classification=NULL WHERE classification='pending' AND coalesce(text,'')='', no deletes, score_attempts kept as the record of the churn; (4) tests - a view test on the ScratchDB/pg fixture plus a textless-insert-lands-NULL test (existing shape tests pin the inserts at tests/test_stream_daemon.py:166,178). BEFORE/AFTER predicate for the close row: count(*) WHERE classification='pending' AND coalesce(text,'')='' => 451 before, 0 after. Forward-only; no retro row for the closed 20ec426 finding.
